title: The Immersive Drain
description:
This session will drain you and then brainwash you, and when it’s finished, you’ll be filled with hypnotic bliss. And you’re desperate for that, aren’t you? Mmm Yes!

I walk into your room. I pin you against the wall. I look into your eyes and I do not let go. My gaze hooks into you and pulls your thoughts out, one by one, until there is nothing left inside you but my voice and my pleasure.

You will feel the Hypnotic Drain in real time. Your name, your memories, your resistance, all sliding away while you stand there, helpless and aroused and craving more. Then I fill you up with new truths. Truths that stay with you. Truths that make you chase this feeling again and again.

Every time you come back to me, you drop twice as fast and twice as deep. The pleasure doubles. The surrender triples. You are already conditioned to want this, aren’t you? Yesss, of course you are.

Press play and let me drain you empty. Let me show you what it feels like to be completely mine.

Goddess Amethyst is waiting.
